children: Correction: Zealand Pharma - Transactions related to share buy-back program (week 35, 2026)
– Zealand Pharma A/S ("the Company" or “Zealand Pharma”)

(CVR-no. 20045078), a biotechnology company transforming the future of metabolic health, hereby corrects information regarding the dates for the reported transactions related to its share buy-back program (the "Program") for week 35 (August 24 – August 28, 2026), initially published in company announcement no. 44 / 2026 on August 31, 2026, as the correct dates for week 35 have now been added to the report on transactions for this period in the reporting table. No other information in the company announcement is affected by this correction, and there has been no change to the annex contained in the original company announcement, which has been reattached to this correction. The complete corrected company announcement is set out below.
Correction to company announcement No. 44/2026 – Full corrected version:
– Zealand Pharma A/S ("the Company" or “Zealand Pharma”)

(CVR-no. 20045078), a biotechnology company transforming the future of metabolic health, today reports transactions related to its share buy-back program (the “Program”) for week 35 (August 24 - August 28, 2026).

The Program is carried out in accordance with Article 5 of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 (the Market Abuse Regulation, “MAR”) and Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2016/1052 (the “Safe Harbour Regulation”). Reference is made to company announcement no. 15 / 2026 dated May 7, 2026, which sets out the full terms of the Program. Under the Program, Zealand Pharma may repurchase shares for a total consideration of up to DKK 1.3 billion. The maximum number of shares that may be acquired under the Program is 7,152,557, and the Program commenced on May 7, 2026, and will be completed no later than October 31, 2026. The Company has appointed Danske Bank as lead manager for the Program. Danske Bank will make its own trading decisions independently of, and without influence from, the Company.
The following transactions have been executed on Nasdaq Copenhagen (XCSE) under the Program during week 35 (August 24, 2026 - August 28, 2026):
Following the transactions described above, Zealand Pharma holds a total of 3,733,842 treasury shares, corresponding to approximately 5.22% of the Company’s share capital.
The total number of shares in Zealand Pharma is 71,578,758, each with a nominal value of DKK 1.
Detailed information on each transaction executed under the Program is available in the appendix to this company announcement.

is a biotechnology company focused on advancing medicines for obesity and metabolic health. Combining more than 25 years of peptide R&D expertise with a proprietary data platform that leverages advanced data driven and AI/ML approaches, Zealand Pharma aims to lead a new era in obesity and metabolic health. To date, more than 10 Zealand Pharma invented drug candidates have entered clinical development, of which two products have reached the market and three candidates are in late-stage development. The Company has collaborations with global pharmaceutical and biotechnology partners for research, development, and commercialization. Founded in 1998, Zealand Pharma is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with a U.S. presence in Boston, Massachusetts. Learn more at www.zealandpharma.com.
